## Context

- The contract and QW-8 (K15 §3.7.1): places are shown by name, not bare code —
  titles, headings, the dossier index and the search index lead with the
  jurisdiction's name with the code secondary, and the two physically mixed
  buckets (`ID` = US `ID` + ISO `ID`, `MN` = US `MN` + ISO `MN`) say plainly which
  two places they combine until the split pages exist (K4 NEW-1).
- The code stays: it is a stable machine-readable identifier and the dossier's
  `subject_label` already embeds it; the jurisdiction-code → adapter mapping
  (`jurisdictionCode`) is untouched (SIG-PUB-017).
- New sentences enter `batch-01.md` as `pending` (B-2 batches + notice
  allowance; operator verbatim confirmation is owed before republish ships them).
- Data stays untouched in both modes: fixture values are already name-form and
  pass through unchanged; export bytes keep the bare code — the display layer
  names it at render time. The `/search/` island's pre-built
  `records.jurisdiction` + `facets("jurisdiction")` stay codes until the export
  regenerates them — that is the exporter-side follow-up (P34.21b), a re-export,
  NOT this ticket (which cannot and must not re-export).

## Plan

1. `web/src/lib/jurisdictions.ts` — the one lookup table: name by code plus the
   `ID`/`MN` combined pairs, `displayJurisdiction()` (name / code / label /
   combines), and `dossierDisplayTitle()` which rewrites the trailing
   " — `CODE`" in a `subject_label` to " — `Name (CODE)`". Source/licence noted
   in-file (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 + ISO 3166-2 subdivision + USPS abbreviations —
   code↔name facts, no third-party copy).
2. Apply it wherever a jurisdiction is shown to a person: dossier title/H1 +
   jurisdiction line + print form (`[slug].astro`, `[slug]/print.astro`),
   dossier index (`dossier/index.astro`), search index (`search.astro`), and the
   home "Jurisdiction reach" list (`index.astro`, which renders the same
   subject/jurisdiction pair). Wire fields (`jurisdiction`, `slug`, `data-*`,
   JSON) keep the code.
3. Mixed-bucket sentence on the ID and MN dossiers (+ print form):
   `This dossier combines {combinesList}.` — literal element bound to batch
   rows `JD-01`/`JD-02`, pending.
4. Tests: vitest `jurisdictions.test.ts` (table covers every connector-emitted
   code; label shape; ID/MN pairs; unresolved fallback), e2e invariants
   (place cells never a bare code; name leads the H1/title; index↔page
   agreement), `tests/unit/test_p34_14_jurisdiction_names.py` (batch rows +
   bindings + conditional rendering + registry coverage), `JD` added to the
   `test_p34_11_copy_batch.py` id pattern.
5. Self-review → verification (`make check`, `npm --prefix web run check`,
   `make ci-local` or the H2 §3.4 equivalent if Docker is unavailable) →
   closeout block + commit → push + PR → CI boundary → closeout record.

  interim scope — P34.21b owns export-byte naming; the combines name and
  the sentence derive from one pair, pinned verbatim by tests; unmapped
  codes can never render as a guessed name (`known:false` + loud label).
